decision.reasoning_trace: Selected products based on a balance of high ratings, review counts, and moderate prices. New Balance Men's Fresh Foam Arishi V2 and Skechers Men's Max Cushioning Premier Vantage-Performance Walking & Running Shoe have high ratings and significant review counts, while Brooks Women's Ghost 14 has the highest rating. ASICS Mens Gel-Venture 6 Running Shoe offers a high rating at an affordable price, and Saucony/Skechers were favored due to their overall pick and high customer satisfaction.
